columns.help: The entries of each SIPOC column in display order, each under its column key. The five column keys are suppliers, inputs, process, outputs and customers.

addItem.help: Appends an entry to one of the five SIPOC columns and returns its position.

params.col: The column: suppliers, inputs, process, outputs or customers. Any other value is an error.
params.text: The entry; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty text is an error.

setItem.help: Replaces the entry at a position of a SIPOC column.

params.col: The column: suppliers, inputs, process, outputs or customers. Any other value is an error.
params.idx: The position of the entry in the column, counted from 0. A position where the column holds no entry is an error.
params.text: The new entry; surrounding whitespace is dropped. An empty text is an error and leaves the old entry in place.

removeItem.help: Removes the entry at a position of a SIPOC column.

params.col: The column: suppliers, inputs, process, outputs or customers. Any other value is an error.
params.idx: The position of the entry in the column, counted from 0. A position without an entry is an error.

moveItem.help: Moves an entry within its column or into another column.

params.fromCol: The column the entry comes from: suppliers, inputs, process, outputs or customers.
params.fromIdx: The position of the entry in fromCol, counted from 0. A position without an entry is an error.
params.toCol: The column the entry goes to: suppliers, inputs, process, outputs or customers.
params.toIdx: The position the entry has AFTER the move, counted from 0. Within the same column at most length − 1, in another column at most its length (append).

topN.help: How many entries the tile shows per SIPOC column, from 1 to 10. Further entries are summarised in the line “+ n more”.
